cvEn:
Arie Yefet, son of Yedida and Yehuda, was born on the 5th of Tevet 5692 (15 December 1931) in Tel Aviv. At first he studied at the Talmud Torah for Yemenite children, and afterward he began working in a mosaic factory.

Arie loved sports from his early youth. He joined the Betar movement, took part in its trips and hikes, trained in boxing, and even competed in youth tournaments. He was known as courageous and determined in his will.

At the age of 15 he joined the Irgun underground and took part in its operations against the British, and from the winter of 5708 (1948) he also acted against the Arabs. While serving as a combat soldier in the Irgun attack on Ramla, he fell on the 24th of Iyar 5708 (2 June 1948), and he was laid to rest in the military cemetery at Nahalat Yitzhak.
